entities.summary: Saint Lucia is a sovereign nation in Caribbean, Americas. Its capital is Castries. Official languages include English. Government: Unitary parliamentary constitutional monarchy (Commonwealth realm). Population: approximately 0.2 million. Area: 617 km². Comprehensive index for Saint Lucia covering Arawak/Kalinago indigenous peoples, Columbus possibly sighted 1502, fierce Kalinago resistance (delayed colonization), French-British rivalry (changed hands 14 times, most in Caribbean), Treaty of Paris 1814 (final British control), sugar/slavery economy, emancipation 1834, independence 1979, French Creole culture/language survival, and tourism economy (Pitons UNESCO landmark).

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Saint Lucia's history of fierce Kalinago resistance and subsequent French-British rivalry delayed colonization, while its sugar/slavery economy led to emancipation in 1834. Its independence in 1979 marked a new era for the nation.
